title: High-energy capacities of unflagged quantum reset channels
provenance: Same involved reviewer as the candidate/dossier audit and earlier research line. Continued full-manuscript review, not blind or an additional independent vote. No subagents used.
recommendation_detail: Scientific content accepted; two nonblocking bibliographic copyedits are recorded. No publication authorization is implied.
technical_quality_scale: 0-10; rigor, completeness, operational precision and reproducibility, separately from impact.

score_rationale.technical: Correct exact finite-dimensional reduction, explicit entropy and energy control, full-environment operational definitions, valid regularization and uniform partner argument. Reproduction and visual inspection passed; minor bibliographic defects remain.
score_rationale.importance: Useful uniform extension to arbitrary finite-energy reset states with coherences and an arbitrary finite-dimensional classical partner. The four asymptotics share one reduction and use established coding/continuity machinery; the vacuum mechanism is already close in Catalano et al. No exact finite-energy capacities, Gaussian thermal-loss result or field-changing application is established.

correctness_confidence.basis: No unresolved material objection after checking every stated proof, boundary regimes and applicable coding hypotheses; numerical checks support identities but are not proofs.

rigor.basis: Finite reference dimension, exact diamond factor, cost slack, limit order, security environment and finite-entropy requirements are explicit.

novelty.basis: Plausible new uniform arbitrary-reset extension and partner transfer; close vacuum antecedents acknowledged. No exhaustive priority certification.

significance.basis: Strong specialized asymptotic result with quantitative bounds. Does not determine finite-energy capacities or settle general additivity.

reproducibility.basis: Frozen PDF/TeX/ZIP verified; supplement reproduces exactly except timestamp; independent 90-digit table check and seven-page visual inspection pass.

summary: The exact seven-page manuscript establishes absolute high-energy erasure-capacity asymptotics for four operational capacities of unflagged oscillator reset channels with arbitrary finite-energy reset states, uniformly for bounded reset energy, plus a uniform classical additivity-defect bound. The scientific claims are supported. Correct the Holevo journal pagination/title and distinguish the Holevo-Shirokov journal title from its arXiv title.
strengths: Exact half-diamond distance equals (1-lambda) Tr(Pi tau), valid for coherent resets and arbitrary references.
Shifted truncated geometric inputs preserve Gibbs entropy up to absolute o(1), with explicit finite-energy bounds.
Operational definitions and source hypotheses exclude confusion with public-discussion key capacity, peak input cost and Gaussian attenuation.
Direct survival-pattern proof gives a partner bound uniform over all finite-dimensional partners after regularization.
Nearby vacuum results are explicitly attributed and no finite-energy equality Q=P is claimed.
weaknesses: Two minor bibliography metadata issues; source identities and required results are nevertheless identifiable.
Current quantitative construction is not asserted optimal or efficiently implementable.
Novelty evidence is limited to the primary sources inspected; impact beyond this specialized channel family is unestablished.
This reviewer participated in prior auditing; no blind or independent additional assessment is present.

potential_errors.finding: English journal citation uses Russian-edition pages 359-374.
potential_errors.correction: A. S. Holevo, Entanglement-Assisted Capacities of Constrained Quantum Channels, Theory Probab. Appl. 48(2), 243-255 (2004), DOI 10.1137/S0040585X97980415.

potential_errors.finding: Preprint title is combined with journal metadata.
potential_errors.correction: Use journal title On classical capacities of infinite-dimensional quantum channels, Problems Inform. Transmission 49(1), 15-31 (2013), DOI 10.1134/S003294601301002X, or explicitly label the preprint-title variant.

strong_novelty_candidates: Uniform absolute four-capacity asymptotics for arbitrary bounded-energy reset states, including number-basis coherences.
Explicit transfer to vanishing classical additivity defect uniformly over every finite-dimensional partner.
optional_improvements: Specify [4, Proposition 3] at the classical regularization step.
Pin version-specific arXiv links, particularly Catalano v2.

visual_review.observations: All formulas and references legible; no clipping, overlap or unresolved citations observed. Original PDF not recompiled or edited.

limitations: No human peer review or additional independent reviewer.
No finite-N capacity solution, optimal convergence rate, efficient code or two-way capacity.
No claim for reset energy growing with N, Gaussian thermal loss, memory or input-dependent reset.
